{{Quote|YOU ARE THE SERVANTS OF THE EMPEROR AND OF THE EMPIRE! YOU ARE THE ENGINE OF CONFLICT. YOU ARE TRANSFORMING THE GALAXY!|Darth Malgus to his Imperial soldiers|<ref name="BoSSftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial soldiers''',<ref name="TOR" /> or '''Imperial Heavy Infantry Soldiers''',<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> also called '''Sith troopers''',<ref name="BoSSftDS" /> '''Imperial troopers'''<ref name="TOR" /> or '''Sith Empire Troopers''',<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> were the [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]]. These Imperial soldiers served as the ground invasion force for the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] campaigns of conquest, and worked to defend the Empire's holdings during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Imperial soldiers were conscripted members of the [[Enlisted]] class&mdash;a social caste within the Empire destined to work in the military under the orders of their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] overlords. Soldiers often worked alongside [[Imperial Guard|Imperial guardsmen]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence Ministry]] [[Imperial Agent|agents]], [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], [[Sith Warrior]]s and [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitors]] on the field of battle.

==Description==
Imperial soldiers were the [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]]. They usually wore black and dark grey [[Imperial Trooper armor|armor]]<ref name="TOR" /> made from [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] plating resistant to hits from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire and other projectiles. The soldier's [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] featured a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] and multiple visual modes and the arm braces were equipped with environmental and targeting controls. The chest of their armor featured a panel similar to<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the one on [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|the suit]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> which provided diagnostic information about the soldiers to [[Medic/Legends|medics]]. Their leg armor was designed to allow for easy mobility and protection from shrapnel.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The soldier's helmets and shoulder [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]s were marked with the Sith Empire's red emblem and their armor also featured an additional red stripe on their chest and colored markings on their knees<ref name="TOR" /> that could indicate unit affiliation or special assignments.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Apart from the usual black armor, the Sith Empire's soldiers would also sometimes wear different similar armor like a red and light grey colored variant.<ref name="TOR" /> They also carried a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with extra ammunition and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], which could be accessed by an [[automated quick-deploy framework]], and five days worth of rations. Imperial soldiers were armed with a sidearm and a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rile]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> from various models<ref name="TOR" /> like the [[TH-17 blaster rifle]].<ref name="GoH" /> All in all, the gear of Imperial soldiers weighed around 45 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] or 100 [[Ponds/Legends|pounds]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Initially all of the Imperial Soldiers were [[Human/Legends|human]], due to the Sith Empire's views on [[Humanocentrism]], this however changed some of the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] many years after, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], with the Empire now allowing [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] within their ranks.

Imperial soldiers operated in small [[Fire team/Legends|Fire Teams]] of two to three troopers, which were part of [[Squad/Legends|squad]]s of five to ten. Ten squads were grouped in to a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]], which in turn was part of a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of 700 to 1500 soldiers in [[Brigade/Legends|brigades]] of 5000 to 7500, which were finally part of a [[Division/Legends|division]] with 20000 to 40000 soldiers. Alternatively, multiple divisions could also be grouped into a special [[Battle group/Legends|Assault Group]] of over 40000 troopers for important large-scale operations commanded by a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] or high-ranking [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. The soldiers were expected to serve the Empire for a period of 25 to 30 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
The system of conscription and the [[Imperial Military training regimen|training regimen]] that soldiers completed were both the creations of [[Odile Vaiken]]&mdash;the father of the Imperial Army and [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|naval armada]], as well as the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Empire. As the Empire grew, Imperial soldiers worked to secure more territory and prepare for the coming war with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Troop/Legends|troops]] succeeded in seizing the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], as well as the rest of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] early in the war, and quickly followed up those victories by assisting in wins on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Begeren]]. Imperial soldiers later participated in the failed attacks on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], as well as the final battle of the war, the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SithTrooper-ConceptArt-ArnieJorgensen.png|thumb|right|125px|Concept art by Arnie Jorgensen]]
The Imperial soldiers were created for the MMORPG [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]] and first released in [[2011]]. Concept art of their final design was done by [[Blur Studio]] and [[Paul Adam]]<ref name="TOR Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and the final in-game model was created by [[Alessandro Baldasseroni]] of Blur Studio.<ref name="Baldasseroni">{{WebCite|url=https://www.eklettica.com/starwars.html|text=Starwars : The Old Republic - Modeling, texturing , surfacing|work=[[Alessandro Baldasseroni]]'s [https://alessandrobaldasseroni.com official website]|archivedate=20250816161829}}</ref> Earlier designs by [[Arnie Jorgensen]] featured different more elongated helmets and bulkier armor. 2011's ''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' notes that the Sith Empire's soldiers were originally supposed to be called "Sith Troopers" before the name was later abandoned in favor of "Imperial soldiers".<ref name="TOR Art" /> Still the name Sith troopers was also still used alongside the new one.

''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia Updated Edition]]'' states the [[Sith trooper]]s from the [[Canon]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] are the modern equivalent to the ancient Imperial soldiers,<ref name="2025 Character Encyclopedia">''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia Updated Edition]]''</ref> however this has yet to be stated in any canon source.
